content:
## Introduction

By the end of [2023](https://optinmonster.com/online-shopping-statistics/), it is anticipated that the total number of active online shoppers in the U.S. alone will be around 300 million. Online shopping has been a boon for the eCommerce industry. The downside is that when unhappy with an online purchase, around [55%](https://razorpay.com/learn/15-powerful-e-commerce-statistics-strategy-2021/) of shoppers prefer to share their experience with family and friends, so bad news travels fast. The payment gateway solution utilized by the e-com seller is also an essential component of the online purchase experience. Thus, the eCommerce industry has now started updating its digital payment systems after realizing the dependability and ease of digital payments is a critical last mile in the customer conversion journey. 

Smartphone penetration has reached almost [80%](https://www.statista.com/statistics/203734/global-smartphone-penetration-per-capita-since-2005/) as a result of the digital revolution post-pandemic, and non-cash retail payments are also expected to expand at a CAGR of [15%](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/financial-services/our-insights/sustaining-digital-payments-growth-winning-models-in-emerging-markets) between 2021 and 2026. Furthermore, in the words of Bill Gates, "The digital revolution has sparked an increase in the access and usage of financial services across the world, revolutionizing methods in which individuals make and receive payments, borrow, and save." 

The digital economy is, without an ounce of doubt, on the rise and so are fintech giants. One such tech giant is ‘[Razorpay](https://razorpay.com/)’, which recently doubled its valuation and stands at [$7.5](https://techcrunch.com/2021/12/19/indian-fintech-giant-razorpay-valued-at-7-5-billion-in-375-million-funding/) billion today. It is a scalable supplier of payment solutions that handle, delivers, and accepts a range of payment options. Razorpay's robust payment gateway enables a variety of payment methods, including EMI, mobile wallets, credit and debit cards, UPI, and net banking.

## Advantages of Razorpay

-   **Best-in-class customer support:** With Razorpay you don’t have to worry about customers' complaints surrounding payment-related errors & setbacks. Razorpay’s customer support takes care of that and helps you better your customer experience.
-   **Currency Conversion**: You can go for international payments and increase your client base and revenue as Razorpay offers real-time conversion for around 100 currencies. Additionally, you can get the link for transactions via email, text messages, and customized payment pages. 
-   **Fraud Prevention & Security**: Fraud prevention and security inevitably rise to the top of the priority list when it comes to digital payments. The payment solution platform rigorously complies with industry-mandated Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS) and safeguards any sensitive information pertaining to any customer. 
-   **Easy Monitoring of Transactions:** With traditional banking, keeping track of transactions made to several clients, suppliers, etc. can be difficult. But with the use of Razorpay's dashboard functionality & sophisticated financial CRM infrastructure, you can even gain important insights into cash flows, money transfers across departments, and other financial activities.

### Move Razorpay data into any data warehouse of your choice with DataChannel

With [DataChannel’s](https://www.datachannel.co/) latest integration with Razorpay, you can easily move your data from Razorpay into the data warehouse of your choice. Simply run & configure your custom data pipeline and get access to reports on: 

-   Customers

-   Settlements
-   Instant Settlements
-   Refunds
-   Disputes 
-   Invoices
-   Items 
-   Subscription Plans
-   Subscription

### Why the need for Razorpay Integration

The eCommerce businesses that use payment gateway platforms like Razorpay have access to a huge amount of data related to customer spending habits, customer segmentation, preferred mode of payment (in a specific region and time zone), and furthermore data about payment related setbacks & errors, and the most purchased product.

The data teams can then either [manually extract](https://datachannel.co/blogs/build-vs-buy-data-pipelines/) and update this data in Google Sheets (or another storage system) on a daily basis, or they can write tedious code to fetch data and somehow make it available to other teams as well. However, both these methods will require a humongous amount of time and effort to code & maintain. This time & effort could be invested in deriving better insights. Thus, arises the need for an automated, no-code, cloud-based data integration infrastructure. With such infrastructure the data can be easily retrieved and stored in a data warehouse simply by scheduling and running custom data pipelines for drawing meaningful insights (and also feeding the same data into various inventory management, CRM, and marketing tools using [Reverse ETL](https://www.datachannel.co/blogs/operational-analytics-getting-started-guide)).

With [ETL](https://www.datachannel.co/blogs/trending-etl-tools-2022) tools such as [DataChannel](https://www.datachannel.co/) you can start streaming your Razorpay data into a single source of truth of your choice and get access to the automated in-depth reports on Refunds, Orders, Subscriptions, etc in minutes with minimal effort. You can easily run your data pipelines to make well-informed business decisions around providing better-targeted customer experience, managing inventory and most importantly reducing losses and driving more revenue.
